requirements.text: Ideal candidates will bring strong academic backgrounds, a tireless work ethic, and have a minimum of 5 years of development experience. Candidates with start\-up experience (particularly in SaaS) and/or AI defense contracting is highly desired.
* Candidates holding either a bachelors or masters degree in Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or other related discipline are highly desired for this role. PhD’s are highly desirable!
* 5\+ years of experience in full\-stack software development with a strong focus on Reach and Node.js.
* Strong system design skills with experience architecting scalable, high\-performance software systems.
* Exceptional knowledge of PHP (Back end), MySQL, relational database design, and able to pull data from databases/design user tables.
* Strong familiarity with HTML, CSS, JS, jQuery, version control systems (Git, SVN), and Linux based web hosting systems/command\-line interfaces.
* Previous experience with MVC (Model View Controller) design patterns, preferably CodeIgnitor (CI) PHP framework. The ability to get up to speed on CI framework is highly desired.
* Awareness and understanding of product technical constraints, resources, scalability constraints, and security principles
* Knowledge of AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes is a plus.

* Work closely with front\-end developers to design and develop functional, performing, and complete APIs or GraphQL, and work tirelessly to define initiatives to improve quality and/or productivity, such as implementing automated test tools or new development methodologies within the team.

**Lead the design and development of our product’s backend systems, and translate software requirements into stable, working, high\-performance software. We’re seeking deeply experienced “doers’ who can switch seamlessly between individual contributors and team leaders.**
* Collaborate with the UX/UI team to implement user\-friendly and visually appealing interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Implement automated testing and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices.

Additionally, you will engage closely with our product team to understand current user needs and anticipate future user needs, facilitating the seamless integration of user requirements into software solutions. Regular interaction with internal and external clients will be essential, as you spearhead user training sessions and gather invaluable feedback to continually refine and enhance our AI platform.
* Is opinionated but enjoys the benefits of being a generalist and not tied down to a specific language, framework, or part of our codebase. Gets tasks done regardless of the conditions.

Ideal candidates will bring strong academic backgrounds, a tireless work ethic, and have a minimum of 5 years of development experience. Candidates with start\-up experience (particularly in SaaS) and/or AI defense contracting is highly desired.
